subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent task completion close only run-owned temporary browser tabs, and which user actions should preserve a tab?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally keep active primary-session tabs reusable, so changing the default needs a product decision about terminal events, tab ownership, and preservation rules before implementation.

options.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
options.body: Track browser tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

options.title: Keep idle/cap behavior only
options.body: Treat the current reusable primary-tab model as sufficient and close or de-scope task-end auto-close if immediate cleanup is too surprising.

options.title: Opt-in strict cleanup
options.body: Add a documented opt-in cleanup mode while preserving current reusable-tab behavior by default.

recommendation.title: Run-owned cleanup with preservation
recommendation.body: Track browser tabs created during a primary-agent run and close only those not explicitly foregrounded, pinned, or requested to be kept.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent implementation and merge history on browser tab cleanup and the related reset cleanup boundary.
